test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (JSO) 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
For the series of the following observations, the coefficient of range leads to which of the following conclusions?

FIRST: 2, 2, 3, 3, 4, 5, 5, 6, 7

SECOND: 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9, 10, 14, 16, 18

THIRD: 1, 3, 4, 4, 5, 7, 8, 8, 9, 10, 12, 12

options.text: Can't make a comparison among dispersion of three series

solution:
The correct answer is** Third series has greatest dispersion.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Third series has greatest dispersion:**

 
 
• Dispersion measures the extent to which values in a data set are spread out. The coefficient of range is calculated as (Maximum value - Minimum value) / (Maximum value + Minimum value).
 
• For the first series: Coefficient of range = (7 - 2) / (7 + 2) = 5/9 ≈ 0.555.
 
• For the second series: Coefficient of range = (18 - 2) / (18 + 2) = 16/20 = 0.8.
 
• For the third series: Coefficient of range = (12 - 1) / (12 + 1) = 11/13 ≈ 0.846.
 
• The third series has the highest coefficient of range, indicating the greatest dispersion among the three series.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Can't make a comparison among dispersion of three series:**

 
 
• This is incorrect because the coefficient of range provides a clear measure to compare the dispersion of different data sets.
 
 
 
• **Second series has greatest dispersion:**
 
 
• While the second series has a high coefficient of range (0.8), it is not the highest compared to the third series (0.846).
 
 
 
• **First series has greatest dispersion:**
 
 
• This is incorrect as the first series has the lowest coefficient of range (0.555) among the three series.
